name: B10-0500/2025 – § 33 – Am 15
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on protection of EU consumers against the practices of certain e-commerce platforms: the case of child-like sex dolls, weapons and other illegal products and materials
part_text: 33. Instructs its President to forward this resolution to the Council, the Commission and the senior executives of Shein, Temu, AliExpress, Wish, Amazon and all other platforms concerned.
